What a STATIC client can actually fetch, by anonymous HTTPS HEAD

Source: R/app_bundle.R
app_capabilities.Rd

Never copied from manifest$capabilities. v7 and v7b both advertise cell_species_list = TRUE because the server-side apps can read a cell_model that lives only on the server; S3 holds tables/ and manifest.json for those releases and nothing else. A manifest describes the SERVER's tables; this describes the bucket.

Usage

app_capabilities(ver, base = atlas_base_url(), sample = list(), timeout = 20)

Arguments

ver

version label

base

atlas base URL from atlas_base_url()

sample

named list of capability -> key relative to {base}/{ver}/, overriding the defaults

timeout

seconds per probe

Value

a list with capabilities (named logicals) and probed

Details

A capability is TRUE only on a 200 (or 206). Anything else — 403, 404, a redirect, a timeout — is FALSE, and the probed URL and status are returned beside it so a FALSE can be explained rather than guessed at.
